401-671-2530-3944.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
Your life total is at least 2.
401-671-2530-3944.description:
Cast Blood Pet by paying {B}.
When Blood Pet enters the battlefield, Carnival of Souls triggers, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, Decaying Soil and Daxos trigger.
Resolve the Decaying Soil trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Blood Pet from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Daxos trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Repeat.

2645-3430-3664-7014.easyPrerequisites: North Pole Patrol doesn't have summoning sickness.
2645-3430-3664-7014.description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding nine mana of any color due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, untapping Lotus Field
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping North Pole Patrol.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

955-4770-6006-6090.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Cat token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3698-4875-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
3698-4875-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru and Grinding Station trigger.
Resolve the Haru trigger, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat steps 2 through 4 once.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 5, causing a player to mill three cards.
Repeat from step 5.

1734-4247-5987.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Angel of Indemnity.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Angel of Indemnity from exile to the battlefield.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Angel of Indemnity.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat from step 3.

765-833-3827-5607.notablePrerequisites: Soul of Windgrace and Klauth can attack without taking damage.
765-833-3827-5607.description:
Declare Klauth and Soul of Windgrace as attackers.
When they attack, Klauth and Soul of Windgrace trigger.
Resolve the Klauth trigger, adding at least nine mana that you will not lose this turn as steps and phases end.
Resolve the Soul of Windgrace trigger, returning Guildless Commons from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Guildless Commons enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
In your next main phase, cast Waves of Aggression from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {3}{R/W}{R/W} and discarding Guildless Commons, causing you to untap all creatures that attacked this turn, and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

2743-5461-7824.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
2743-5461-7824.description:
Activate Calamity's saddle ability by tapping Biovisionary, causing Calamity to become saddled until end of turn.
Declare Calamity as an attacker.
Calamity triggers, creating four token copies of Biovisionary that are tapped and attacking.
At the beginning of your end step, Calamity triggers four times and each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first Biovisionary trigger, causing you to win the game.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3668-5399.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3668-5399.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Flesh Duplicate and Pirated Copy each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Flesh Duplicate trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Pirated Copy trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3668-5399.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1987-2020-4125.easyPrerequisites:
You control an artifact, creature or land that taps to produce at least {U}
Vadrik has at least 2 power.
1987-2020-4125.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Shipwreck Dowser.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-2020-4125.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with four or more quest counters on it

4377-7012-7722.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Blink Thor using Airbender Ascension.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Walk the Aeons from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Walk the Aeons from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

2523-2869-2897.description:
Cast Gigantoplasm by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Ratadrabik.
Put Gigantoplasm into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Gigantoplasm dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Gigantoplasm that is a copy of Ratadrabik but is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 2 using the Gigantoplasm token instead.
2523-2869-2897.notes: This combo produces a mandatory infinite loop that'll cause the game to end in a draw if it isn't interacted with.

997-3490-4455-7426.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
997-3490-4455-7426.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Ghost Lantern triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta and Animation Module trigger.
Resolve the Berta trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat

560-1563-2457-4478.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-2034-4907-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {2}. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Tatterkite, adding {C}{C}
Repeat.

4907-5315-6747-6989.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
4907-5315-6747-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Sami. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static effect.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

2173-3944-5220-7286.description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it.
When Blood Pet dies, Mortuary and South Wind Avatar trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Blood Pet from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
South Wind Avatar triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Blood Pet from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

225-4222-7069.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U} due to Tectonic Split
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Tectonic Split.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Repeat.

1402-2218-4068-4763.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
1402-2218-4068-4763.description:
Cast Diamond Lion by paying {2}.
When Diamond Lion enters, Ronin Warclub triggers, attaching itself to Diamond Lion.
Activate Diamond Lion by tapping it, sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any color.
When Diamond Lion dies, Koll triggers, returning Diamond Lion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3652-3967-5220-6900.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Ornithopter
When Ornithopter dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Ornithopter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Cast Ornithopter from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

4311-5051-5078-6723.description:
Activate Traxos by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

191-5435-6625.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
191-5435-6625.description:
Activate Dream Trawler by discarding a card.
Curator of Mysteries triggers, causing you to scry 1.
Matoya triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Dream Trawler ability.
Repeat.

1445-2279-2438-4871.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2279-2438-4871.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2105-3204-5223-6188.notablePrerequisites:
Fear of Missing Out cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
Mysterious Limousine does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mysterious Limousine.
2105-3204-5223-6188.description:
Declare either Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant and Mysterious Limousine as attackers.
Mysterious Limousine and either Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant trigger, untapping Mysterious Limousine and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Mysterious Limousine trigger, exiling Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant from the battlefield, and then returning Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

64-2061-2103.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Capture of Jingzhou each turn.
64-2061-2103.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Warden of the Eye.
When the Warden of the Eye token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-5189-5231-5439.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one removable +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
1270-5189-5231-5439.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating three 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Adaptive Gemguard by tapping two Saprolings, putting a +1/+1 counter on Adaptive Gemguard.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing a Saproling, adding {R}.
Repeat.

2486-5147--5.notablePrerequisites:
The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
You control your commander.
2486-5147--5.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to your commander's ability granted to it by Master Chef.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1115-3259-5359.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1115-3259-5359.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Threefold Thunderhulk as attackers.
Threefold Thunderhulk triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1003-3156-4336-4763.notablePrerequisites: Demonmail Hauberk attached to Kobolds of Kher Keep.
1003-3156-4336-4763.description:
Activate Demonmail Hauberk's equip ability by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep, targeting Phyrexian Walker.
When Kobolds of Kher Keep dies, Koll triggers, returning Kobolds of Kher Keep from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Phyrexian Walker.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
Activate Demonmail Hauberk's equip ability by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker, targeting Kobolds of Kher Keep.
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Koll triggers, returning Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Kobolds of Kher Keep.
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying {0}.
Repeat.

859-1284.notablePrerequisites:
Viridian Longbow attached to Lurking Roper.
Lurking Roper does not have summoning sickness.
You have a way to give Lurking Roper lifelink.
859-1284.description:
Activate Lurking Roper by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain one life.
Lurking Roper triggers, untapping it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Jorn, God of Winter // Kaldring, the Rimestaff

1025-2010.notablePrerequisites:
Jorn does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one snow permanent that can tap to produce at least {U}.
1025-2010.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Stasis triggers.
Holding priority, activate a snow permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Resolve the Stasis ability, causing you to pay {U}.
Declare Jorn as an attacker.
Jorn triggers, untapping each snow permanent you control.
Repeat during each of your turns.

2367-3000-3490-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing a creature, adding {R}.
Unruly Mob triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, costing you {1} to create two 1/1 Servo creature tokens.
Repeat.

925-1486-1651.description:
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Adaptive Automaton and another artifact, targeting Adaptive Automaton.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Clock of Omens ability, untapping Adaptive Automaton.
Repeat.

101-618-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn.
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Vampire Charmseeker with haste.
The token copy of Vampire Charmseeker enters the battlefield, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

2060-2854-3129-3977.notablePrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds has 2 or 3 lore counters on it.
2060-2854-3129-3977.description:
Cast Horned Kavu, putting 2 +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler with Showdown of the Skalds.
Remove 2 +1/+1 counter from Crystalline Crawler to add {R}{G}.
Horned Kavu triggers, returning itself to your hand.
Repeat.
